archetypes.name: dyn-artifact-context
archetypes.rationale: Declared-context and manifest propagation now gate remote mutation and rendering paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the shared implement-context resolver and every explicit-manifest propagation call. Verify standalone behavior remains available only when no context signal exists, while invalid-present artifacts fail closed before mutation or fallback. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
